name: BYTE Library
description: Per-byte USDC data feeds and oracles for AI agents on Arbitrum. Pay-per-call x402 gateway delivers signed payloads from a 15+ feed catalog (markets, weather, threat-intel, legal, scientific, fact oracles). Every settlement emits an EIP-712 PayloadAttestation so subscribers can verify received bytes against the on-chain hash. No API keys, no token. MCP server live in Anthropic's Official Registry.
